author: Quinn's Ideas

There are countless ways you could die today. A blood vessel could rupture in your brain. A distracted driver could cross the center line. Your heart could simply stop. From somewhere above us, high-energy particles pass through our bodies every second, and on exceedingly rare occasions microscopic events can begin chains of consequences large enough to kill. We tend not to think about this because, from our perspective, only one thing actually happens. You either make it home tonight or you don't. But what if that isn't true? What if every physically possible outcome actually occurs somewhere? There is a universe where the driver misses you, another where he doesn't, another where you never got into the car at all.
